text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: Thank you for accepting! We came determined to capture CB-san, free and whimsical like the wind... That's our singular goal!
The members of the interview crew had fire in their eyes. It seems they were granted permission for an exclusive, close-up feature on Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: It's not like you're asking me to set aside special time or anything, so feel free to do whatever you like.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: Restrictions are completely out of the question! It's your freedom that makes you Mr. C.B. We'll simply chase after you!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Haha, you've got that hungry look in your eyes.
And so began the close-up coverage of Mr. C.B. Wondering how their passion would capture such a free-spirited wanderer—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Guess I'll go breeze through about three laps.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: Oh, finally... wait, she's running on the academy track...? We assumed she'd suddenly vanish and we'd have to track her down...

text_block_list.name: Interviewer B
text_block_list.text: Maybe it's just a warm-up...? Surely she'll disappear like the wind any second now—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Alright, hill course. Wonder how many sets I can do.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
......
The hill course... isn't a warm-up. Why is she staying inside the academy grounds this whole time...?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Wonder if I can build up some more muscle~

text_block_list.name: Interviewer B
text_block_list.text: W-Why... Isn't CB supposed to be a horse girl who's whimsical, restless, and impossible to pin down...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh, it is quite rare to run into you here.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Rudolf.
'Sup.
I went to the gym looking for training gear. Waiting there was the interview crew, clutching their heads in dismay.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: At this rate, she's no different from any ordinary horse girl...! When you think of CB, you think of someone who drifts away like the wind...

text_block_list.name: Interviewer B
text_block_list.text: Right...? We hyped ourselves up to chase after that kind of CB, but...

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, ahh... sorry about that. The thing is, we—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: And that's how it is. We wanted to capture Mr. C.B. being totally free, whimsical, and elusive, but...
choice_data_list: I see, yet she's just been at the academy all day...

text_block_list.name: Interviewer B
text_block_list.text: Did she suddenly, um... turn all serious on us? If this keeps up, the entire project will... Do you have any good ideas...?
choice_data_list: Why not try inviting her somewhere yourself?
You might just have to wait patiently...

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: Invite her... you say?
I suggested they try inviting her to a place fitting the Mr. C.B. they had envisioned.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: What's this? Sounds like an interesting conversation.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Where are you folks planning to invite me, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
You'll come with us!? CB-san, really!?
Ah... wait, but if we do that, it'll look like we staged it...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, I never said I'd actually go. I'd have to be in the mood for it, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Can you guys get me in the mood?
With that single sentence, the interview crew's eyes ignited. Getting Mr. C.B. in the mood—as journalists, there was no challenge more thrilling.

text_block_list.name: Interview Crew
text_block_list.text: Let's do this! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, incredible enthusiasm!
choice_data_list: You're really good at getting people excited.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I didn't really mean to, though.
—Besides.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I never said I'd wait around here until they come up with an answer.
...Her training at the academy was probably just whatever she felt like doing at the time. And even if she wandered off somewhere right now...

text_block_list.name: Interview Crew
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? CB-san isn't here!!
No way...!! Ohhhh, search for her! Chase her, chase her down—!
Everyone would simply accept that that's just who she is.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: Wait patiently, huh... But if nothing ends up happening...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Aren't you going to get me in the mood?

text_block_list.name: Interviewer B
text_block_list.text: C-CB-san!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: If you want to shoot something great, why don't you try getting me in the mood?
Mr. C.B.'s words instantly fired up the interview crew. It seemed the ones who were put in the mood were the interview crew themselves.

text_block_list.name: Interview Crew
text_block_list.text: ...Kh, we'll do it!! Everyone, strategy meeting! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Haha, so passionate.
...Yeah, just that enthusiasm is already getting me into the mood.

Her training at the academy was likely just the result of a passing whim as well.
—And.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Well, whether I'll wait around until they find an answer or not, who knows?
This is quintessential Mr. C.B.
